title: Guest web-chat local regression fixes, 5 October 2026

checkout.testedVersion: Current working tree, identified by the before/after hashes below. Existing unrelated changes were preserved.

identifiedCode.purpose: Guest UI, conversation state, session/draft recovery, Send/Enter and message/button rendering
Tenant-scoped handler, intent routing, booking selection, contact steps, confirmation and transcript audit
Existing quantity/intent utilities, pricing, signed sessions and custom booking questions

confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.reproduce: Use the real handler with the three-tour fixture, reach ASK_DETAILS for Morning Kayak, then request Sunset Paddle and later Midday Hike. Also name two alternatives, reject the old tour, or request Switch to Dolphin Cruise.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.before: The correction route recognized only a narrow generic change-tour command. Named or unknown switches fell into contact parsing, could replace the guest name, and retained the old booking.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.after: Corrections route first. A unique active named tour is selected and confirmed; ambiguous/unknown requests ask which valid tour to use. Only valid contacts and the unconfirmed group preference survive; old date/time, quantity confirmation, extras, custom answers, vouchers and quote are removed and fresh inventory/pricing is checked.

confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.contract: The existing prompt permits full name, email and phone together or one detail at a time; all three are required before confirmation.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.reproduce: At ASK_DETAILS send Email: guest.example.com, Email: guest@@example.com, Phone: abcdef, malformed mixed input, whitespace, or names with apostrophes/Unicode/more than six words. Also send Name: Friday Moyo and Email: wednesday@fixture.invalid.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.before: Valid-looking substrings were extracted and remaining labels/punctuation were stripped; malformed contact text became a name. ASCII apostrophes were removed and a six-word restriction rejected legitimate names. Broad scheduling detection misread weekdays inside labeled contact details.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.after: Full field validation prevents fallback of obvious email/phone input into a name. Invalid mixed messages preserve all previous valid details, show field-specific guidance and remain at contact collection. International names and explicit country-code phones are preserved/canonicalized without inferring a country. Labeled contacts win over weekday detection. UI prevalidation and required server confirmation checks share the tested contract.

confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.issue: Old rejected time after a date change
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.reproduce: Reject 06:00 on the first Morning Kayak date, then type or choose the next date which has only 11:00. Request an unavailable 07:00 on that new date. Delay old availability before completing a newer selection, including refresh/remount.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.before: Date correction reused pendingTime from the old rejected request, producing a misleading error for the new date.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.after: A different date clears the old departure and time request/error unless a new time is explicitly supplied. Only current-date options and errors are returned. Existing synchronous request locking and version/unmount guards were traced and preserved; controlled delayed and out-of-order tests verify newer UI state wins.

confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.reproduce: Reach contacts after a valid quantity; the prior instruction included literal *(All in one message ...)* in a plain React text bubble.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.before: Deterministic Markdown emphasis was sent to a renderer that deliberately displays escaped text.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.after: Contact/custom-question instructions are plain text. Assistant emphasis and bullet markers are converted consistently in bubbles and button labels while React still escapes HTML. Fixture img/script payloads produce no executable DOM or script.

confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.issue: Supplied party count asked for again
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.reproduce: At contacts send Make it 3 people, Change party size to 3 people, Change the number of people to 3, or 3 people. Use controlled capacities 3 and 6 and a changed slot rate.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.before: Navigation to ASK_QTY worked but discarded the supplied count. A bare 3 people could additionally overwrite the saved name.
confirmedCausesAndBehaviour.after: The valid unambiguous count is applied immediately through refreshed capacity and price checks. Ambiguous, fractional, negative and over-capacity corrections ask a focused quantity question without retaining an invalid quote. Sold-out fixture departures return to available dates.

changedFiles.purpose: Route booking corrections before contacts, rebuild tour state, invalidate old dates/times/quotes, apply counts using live capacity/current pricing, and validate required contacts before the mocked submission boundary.
Pure contact parsing and field validation for the all-at-once or one-at-a-time collection contract; preserve valid previous details on invalid mixed input.
Identical validator inside the independently deployed guest app; parity is tested.
Accessible contact correction errors, safe plain-text assistant/button rendering, and unsent draft persistence across refresh; keep existing request locks/version guards.
International names/phones, whitespace, missing fields, malformed/mixed contacts and mirrored-source parity.

Actual-handler regression cases for two tour switches, ambiguous/unknown tours, weekday contact fields, rejected-time/date changes, inline counts/capacity/pricing and required server contact validation.
UI prevalidation, repeated Send lock, out-of-order availability and plain-text formatting.
Use the actual contact/pricing module exports and provide the contact-error setter in the existing reset harness. This file also had unrelated pre-existing changes.
Allow the snapshotted pre-fix handler to be executed and load actual contact/pricing modules with database/payment/email mocks.
Three controlled tours with distinct departures, capacities and price overrides; local-only inventory/failure controls.
Build the independent guest checkout with local-only credentials and disabled Sentry upload; remove only this temporary build cache after successful compilation.
Fourteen added browser scenarios covering the requested regressions and preserving existing interaction/recovery tests.

earlierFailures.resolution: Each confirmed defect now has passing focused regression coverage.

Three failures expected a retired calendar button to remain disabled; the assertion now matches the existing UI contract. Seven desktop failures were startup/interaction timeouts during disk exhaustion; WebKit also reported ENOSPC while saving a trace. Only this task’s generated build cache was removed and the preview helper now removes its own cache. The fresh full run passed all 102 checks.
The same approved Playwright command was rerun with local network/browser execution permission; no production access was introduced.
Weekday contacts, unknown tour switches and bare party counts have passing handler and browser coverage.

Delayed/out-of-order responses, rapid buttons, double Send and Enter/Send

remainingRisks: Contact validation establishes syntax, not email deliverability or phone reachability.

manualRetestChecklist: In a local/sandbox environment complete each tour to contacts. Change tours twice and verify only the last tour, current departure and recalculated total appear in the summary; stop before real confirmation.
Reject a time, choose a date with different departures and verify the old time/error disappears. Delay availability and confirm the newer date remains selected.

Try Unicode/apostrophe/hyphen names, malformed labeled and mixed contacts, missing fields, and Name: Friday Moyo. Verify valid saved details survive, corrections stay at contacts, and messages show no raw Markdown.
Try 3 people and party changes below/at/above fixture capacity; change price/capacity and simulate network/sold-out cases. Verify current price/capacity feedback and no booking is submitted.
Double click and use Enter/Send; try Back/cancel, close/reopen, refresh with an unsent draft, and Restart at several steps. Check 320/375/430 widths, focus and loading/disabled controls.
